title: Sample question bank — drive a reproducible quiz with ask_question

questions.question: Which Revit API class is used to iterate over elements in a document?
What must wrap any change to the Revit model?
In one sentence, what does a Revit Transaction do?
questions.expected: Groups one or more model changes so they are committed or rolled back atomically; required for any modification.

questions.question: What internal length unit does the Revit API use?
questions.expected: Decimal feet (imperial feet) regardless of the document's display units.
